about_the_game:
Anne and Mary’s Hunt for Booty tis a side-scrollin' adventure chock full of addictive gameplay rooted in the timelessness of ol' brawlers. Slash yer way through fancy environments and shoot down waves o' British Naval scallywags with the fierce female pirates, both inspired by historical buccaneers!

Pick yer fighter, defeat yer enemies, and plunder yer way through fierce battles packed with breathtaking action and wild swashbucklin' tricks. Be one of the few to know the tale of Anne and Mary's clash with pirate-turned-privateer, John Barnet and his motley English crew. Better yet, grab a mate and go local co-op! Before your eyes be a true labor o' love from a volunteer game development crew.

Features:
● Classic brawler design takes you back to the ’90s
● Highly stylized and iconic cartoon graphics
● Old-school gameplay with fast and fresh mechanics
● Local Co-Op supported
● Play as historical pirate icons and learn more of their story
● Become a pirate expert in quick and fun game shows.
● And a realization tellin' of pirate history unlike any other. 

Best part, ya keep yer doubloons! So, what are ye waitin' for?

content_descriptors.notes: Contains depictions of marijuana and alcohol abuse, cleavage, and passionate kissing.

short_description: Anne and Mary's Hunt for Booty is a fast-paced 2D beat 'em up. Play as historical pirates Anne Bonny and/or Mary Read, shoot and slash through the British fleet, and save the cowardly captain from a nasty privateer! Features swashbucklin' beats, local co-op, and art stylized by '90s cartoons.
